distinguishes: Under bond a ticket paymaster must be staked, and is refused when banned and, at its pending limit, when throttled, all before CG-2's checks and before any proof; seen counts each of its transactions once, a junk proof when its proof fails and any other at admission, and included counts FP-15's step 1; the counters refresh every refresh_seconds; a transaction that pays for itself has no ticket paymaster; without bond none of this applies.

cases.name: a bonded ticket paymaster: admitted, counted once in seen
cases.derivation: tpm has code, a stake of 10^18 and a delay of 86400: bonded. A's proof verifies, so A counts in seen when the pool admits it, once.

cases.name: an unstaked ticket paymaster is refused, and nothing is counted
cases.derivation: loose has no stake. CG-3 runs CG-11 for A and refuses the wrapper with its code, so no proof is verified; B is refused at admission before AG-6. Neither is counted.

cases.name: a stake too small, a delay too short, a stake being withdrawn, an account without code
cases.derivation: Bonded is AM-3's staked: a stake of at least min_stake_value (low has 10^17), a delay of at least min_unstake_delay (short has 3600), withdrawing false (leaving), and code that is not empty (bare has none).

cases.name: the bond comes before CG-2's checks
cases.derivation: CG-11 runs after FP-6 and before CG-2: an unbonded paymaster's ticket is refused without its signature or its epoch being looked at; a bonded one's goes on to CG-2.

cases.name: a transaction that pays for itself has no ticket paymaster
cases.derivation: A's payer is its sender, so it has no ticket paymaster: CG-11 checks nothing and counts nothing for it.

cases.name: a banned paymaster is refused before its ticket
cases.derivation: m = floor(510 / 10) = 51 > 0 + 50: BANNED. The ban comes before CG-2, so B's invalid ticket is refused as banned; nothing refused here is counted.

cases.name: 509 is throttled, not banned
cases.derivation: m = 50, not above 50, and 0 + 10 < 50: THROTTLED, with no pending transaction, so A passes CG-11 and is admitted; its count at admission makes seen 510 and m = 51: BANNED, so B is refused. A stays pending.

cases.name: junk proofs count in seen, and the 510th bans
cases.derivation: A junk proof's transaction passed the bond, the ticket and the prefix (CG-3), and counts in seen when its proof fails at AG-5's step 5, since it is never admitted. At 510, m = 51: BANNED.

cases.name: an inclusion counts in included
cases.derivation: FP-15's step 1 removes A, whose nonce the block consumed: the model's inclusion, which adds 1 to tpm's included.

cases.name: a transaction in an aggregate counts at its admission
cases.derivation: A mode 1 wrapper carries no proof of A's own; the pool admits A, which adds 1 to seen.

cases.name: a refresh lifts a ban
cases.derivation: m = 53 > 50: BANNED. At 3600 s of the pool's time seen = floor(530 * 23 / 24) = 507, m = 50: throttled, not banned, and A, with none pending, is admitted.

cases.name: a throttled paymaster backs four pending at most, where FP-11 lets it pay for more
cases.derivation: m = 20 > 0 + 10 and not above 50: THROTTLED. With four pending under tpm, E is refused at CG-3 before its proof, so it is not counted.

cases.name: under claim-gated's own FP-11 the throttle does not bind
cases.derivation: FP-11 holds a non-canonical paymaster to one pending transaction, fewer than throttled_entity_mempool_count: B passes CG-11 with one pending, its proof verifies, and the pool refuses it at FP-11. Only A, admitted, is counted.

cases.name: without bond, version 4's admission
cases.derivation: With bond false CG-11 does not apply: an unstaked paymaster and a banned one are each a payer like any other.
